sections.title: Getting started
sections.intro: How to install Zeus and open it for the first time.
steps: Install Java 21, the Fabric Loader for Minecraft 1.21.11 and Fabric API for 1.21.11.
Put the Zeus jar into your .minecraft/mods folder and start the Fabric 1.21.11 profile.
The intro film plays once (press any key to skip), then the Zeus main menu appears.
Join a world and press Z to open the Zeus panel. Click a module's switch to turn it on.
Click a module row to open its settings. Click the None chip and press a key to bind it.
Press the Panic button (bottom right of the panel) or type /zeus panic to switch everything off.
tips: Settings save automatically to config/zeus.json.
/zeus tutorial replays the animated tour of every category.
Type in the search box at the top of the panel to find any module by name, description or category.

sections.title: The Zeus panel
sections.intro: The panel is where you switch modules on and tune them. It opens with Z in a world, or with /zeus.
steps: Use the category rail on the left to jump between Combat, Movement, Player, World, Visuals, Base Finding, Tools, Friends, HUD & Info and Interface.
Search at the top matches names, descriptions and categories, and it copes with small typos. Ctrl+K focuses it.
Click a switch to toggle a module. Click anywhere else on the row to open its settings.
Each setting has a short explanation. Sliders, choices, text fields and buttons all save instantly.
Give any module its own key with the None chip on its card.
tips: Enable Remember enabled modules to get your modules back after restarting.
Panic switches every module off at once.

sections.title: Combat
sections.intro: Auras, aim helpers, crystal and anchor tools, auto armor and totems, and trap modules.
steps: Start with the helpers that are easiest to understand: Auto Totem, Auto Armor and Auto Weapon.
Aura modules (Kill Aura, Crystal Aura, Anchor Aura) act on targets near you. Check their range, delay and target settings first.
Use Smooth Aim Assist or Triggerbot for gentler help than a full aura.
Trap and surround modules (Surround, Self Trap, Auto Trap, Hole Filler, Auto Web) place blocks around you or a target.
tips: Combat modules are the most likely to be noticed by server anti-cheat. Test them in your own world first.
MultiAura is a single-player practice tool and refuses to run on servers.

sections.title: Movement
sections.intro: Flight, speed, jumping, climbing, boats, elytra and safety nets.
steps: Flight, Speed, Step and High Jump change how you move. Start with low values and raise them slowly.
No Fall, Anti Void and Safe Walk are safety nets for risky terrain.
Boat Fly and Boat NoClip control vehicles. Advanced Elytra Autopilot flies towards coordinates you type in.
Scaffold places blocks under your feet as you walk.
tips: Servers decide movement. Many correct or punish speed and flight, so use these where they are allowed.
Safe Walk and No Fall are low-profile helpers compared with Flight.

sections.title: Player
sections.intro: Quality-of-life helpers for your own character: eating, tools, fishing and respawning.
steps: Auto Eat eats when you are hungry. Auto Tool picks the best tool for the block you are mining.
Auto Respawn skips the death screen. Anti AFK keeps you from being kicked for idling.
Morph changes how you look to yourself. It is visual only.
Auto Fish handles the bobber for you.
tips: Morph is for your own eyes only; other players never see it.

sections.title: World
sections.intro: Mining and building helpers, plus X-Ray.
steps: X-Ray hides ordinary blocks so ores stand out. Use its opacity slider to choose how visible the rest of the world stays.
Fast Break and Fast Place speed up mining and building.
Area Clearer clears a region you choose.
Tree Bot and Tunnel Miner are single-player helpers and refuse to run on servers.
tips: X-Ray uses a render hook. If it does nothing on your setup, the card's status text says why.
Zeus only shows blocks the server actually sent. It cannot reveal hidden terrain.

sections.title: Visuals
sections.intro: ESPs, tracers, trajectories, light overlays, freecam and sky controls.
steps: ESP draws players and mobs. Pick a Shape (glow, box, fill or both) and set an entity cap to keep it fast.
Item ESP highlights dropped items from a list of item:colour pairs. Block ESP and the specialised ESPs highlight blocks you choose.
Fullbright, Time Changer and Weather Changer adjust what you see, client side only.
Freecam moves only the camera. Your body stays put.
tips: Overlays are drawn on screen and can drift slightly while you sprint.
Friends get their own colour on ESPs.

sections.title: Base Finding
sections.intro: Scanners that read chunk data your game already loaded and point to likely player bases.
steps: Suspicious Chunks scores loaded chunks for signs of building. Higher scores are more likely to be a base.
Advanced Base Finder and Tunnel Base Finder specialise the score for surface and underground bases.
Storage ESP, Spawner ESP and the other ESPs mark the specific blocks that give bases away.
Media Base Finder works on servers that put media accounts in 09- scoreboard teams and gives an estimated search area.
tips: Scanners only see chunks inside your render distance.
A score is a hint, not proof. Natural structures and modded builds can fool it.

sections.title: Tools
sections.intro: Waypoints, schematics, auction helpers, notifiers and macros.
steps: Waypoints saves places (also /zeus waypoint add <x> <y> <z> [name]).
Schematic Library and Schematic Builder import .schem and .litematic files and guide placement in single-player.
Auction House Tweaks and Auto Sell help with the auction house. Zeus only completes a purchase if you arm the AH Sniper yourself.
Chat Macro 1, 2 and 3 send a message when you press a key. Discord Webhook posts events to a webhook you provide.
tips: Schematics go in config/zeus/schematics. Litematica's own folder is scanned too.

sections.title: Friends
sections.intro: Keep a list of friends and choose how they stand out.
steps: Open Friends and add names by typing them or from your clipboard.
Friends get their own look on ESPs and name tags. For each friend you choose how you see them: a glow, a bigger name tag, a tag above the head and more.
Friends Panel shows your friends on the HUD.
tips: The list holds up to 30 names.

sections.title: HUD & the HUD editor
sections.intro: Widgets on your screen, and an editor to place them where you want.
steps: Switch widgets on in the HUD & Info category (Armor HUD, Keystrokes, Potion HUD, Info, Staff HUD and more). Scanners and tools with a HUD card, like Media Base Finder, Suspicious Chunks, Advanced Base Finder, Tunnel Base Finder, Zeus Sense, Friends Panel and Fake Scoreboard, show up in the editor too.
Open the editor with /zeus hud or from Interface settings. Every widget gets an outline.
Drag a widget to move it. It snaps to the screen edges, the centre lines and other widgets, with pink guide lines.
Use the mouse wheel to scale, the arrow keys to nudge one pixel, R to reset and U to undo.
The floating panel sets position, scale, opacity and colour, and the List tab lets you switch widgets on or off.
tips: Press G for a grid and S to toggle snapping.
Drag the panel by its title bar if it covers a widget.
Widgets only appear in the editor while their module is on, so switch on Media Base Finder, Suspicious Chunks or Advanced Base Finder first.
27 widgets can be moved and scaled: every HUD & Info panel plus the cards of the scanners and tools above.

sections.title: Interface & themes
sections.intro: Look and feel, privacy options and the optional website.
steps: Zeus Customs (from the menu or panel) changes the main menu, intro film and animations.
Streamer Privacy hides your coordinates and name on screen.
Fake Scoreboard and Hide Scoreboard change the sidebar scoreboard.
Web Dashboard lets the website's Settings page control your running game.
tips: The Classic menu link in the corner of the Zeus menu returns to the vanilla title screen.

sections.title: Website & control center
sections.intro: The Settings page of the website can control the Zeus running in your game, from any browser on your computer.
steps: In Minecraft, switch on Interface, then Web Dashboard (or type /zeus website).
Click the link in chat. It opens the control center, which only your computer can reach (it listens on 127.0.0.1).
Open the Settings page and paste the access token (Copy the access token button, or click it in chat).
Switch modules, edit any setting, save presets, schedule changes and watch live status.
tips: Turn on Keep the same access token if you want a bookmarked, signed-in page to survive restarts.
/zeus website stop shuts the site down.

sections.title: Servers, rules & safety
sections.intro: Zeus is a cheat client, so here is what to know about servers.
steps: Read the rules of every server before enabling a module on it.
Test new modules in a single-player world first.
Use Panic (or /zeus panic) when you need everything off immediately.
Never download Zeus from anywhere except the official link on this site.
tips: Servers are authoritative. They can correct or punish anything Zeus does.
Zeus has no ban protection and cannot promise you will not be banned.

sections.title: Troubleshooting
sections.intro: Quick fixes for the most common problems.
steps: The game does not start: check that you use the Fabric 1.21.11 profile, Java 21 and Fabric API for 1.21.11.
The Z key does nothing: rebind it in Minecraft's Controls under the Zeus category, or type /zeus.
A module does nothing: open its card and read the Status text; the log file logs/latest.log has lines starting with Zeus.
Everything feels laggy: lower the entity cap on ESPs and switch off scanners you are not using.
The website will not open: run /zeus website status, check the port, then /zeus website again.
Still stuck: ask on Discord and include the Status text and the Zeus lines from the log.
tips: Zeus lines in logs/latest.log are the most useful thing to send when asking for help.

faq.q: What is Performance Guard?
faq.a: A module that switches the costliest ESPs and scanners off by itself when your FPS stays under a limit you set, and switches them back on once the frame rate has recovered. You choose the limit, how many it switches off at a time, whether it touches only scanners or any module, and it tells you in chat what it did. It never touches a module you switched off yourself.
faq.keys: performance guard auto disable fps limit esp heavy switch off automatically

faq.q: How do I bind a key to a module?
faq.a: Type /zeus keybinds, or switch on the Keybinds module. Every module is listed with its key: click a key box, press the key you want, and it is saved. Backspace or a right click clears a key, and a key that two modules share is marked. They are the same keys that Options > Controls shows.
faq.keys: keybind key bind hotkey shortcut keyboard assign toggle module

faq.q: How do I get told about a new Zeus version?
faq.a: Switch on Update Checker and give it the address of the version file that the website build writes (version.json). Every time you join a server it compares versions and, if a newer one exists, shows a chat line and a pop-up at the top of the screen for about five seconds. It does nothing until you set the address.
faq.keys: update checker new version notification popup latest download

faq.q: Does Zeus mark where I died?
faq.a: Yes. The Death Marker module remembers the place you died and shows a marker with the distance so you can find your items. It is kept in memory only, so it is gone when you leave the game, and you can clear it with its button.

faq.q: How do I add or remove Staff Live channels?
faq.a: Open Staff Live in the panel. Type the channel name, pick YouTube, TikTok or Twitch and press Add; remove a channel with its Remove button. The check is a best-effort read of the channel page, so a channel can show as unknown when the site changes or blocks the request.

faq.q: Which knives does Zeus have?
faq.a: The butterfly knife, the karambit and eighteen knives modelled on the CS2 line-up: Bayonet, M9 Bayonet, Huntsman, Flip, Gut, Falchion, Bowie, Navaja, Stiletto, Talon, Ursus, Classic, Paracord, Survival, Nomad, Skeleton, Kukri and the Shadow Daggers.
